summary: A reference for designers of custom watchfaces for the AAPS(Custom) watchface: the zip and JSON format, a step-by-step guide to a first design, advanced features (preferences, twin views, dynData, dynPref, formatting, follower data), and tables of every JSON key and value. Almost all terms are JSON identifiers and file names that must stay in English; the few app labels are the Wear plugin buttons and watch settings.

sections.heading: Custom Watchface Reference Document
sections.summary: Introduction: a reference for designers creating custom watchfaces, listing every keyword and feature.

sections.heading: Custom Watchface Format
sections.summary: What a custom watchface zip must contain (the CustomWatchface preview image and CustomWatchface.json) and which extra images and fonts it may include. The preview is what the user sees after pressing Load Watchface in the phone's Wear plugin; the zip feeds the AAPS(Custom) watchface on the watch.

sections.heading: JSON Structure
sections.summary: Basics of JSON syntax for editing CustomWatchface.json in a text editor.

sections.heading: Metadata Settings
sections.summary: The mandatory metadata block (name, author, dates, versions) at the start of the JSON file.

sections.heading: General parameter settings
sections.summary: The general parameters block that sets graph colours and default BG colours.

sections.heading: ImageView settings
sections.summary: JSON block for an image view: position, size, visibility and colour tint.

sections.heading: TextView settings
sections.summary: JSON block for a text view: rotation, text size, alignment, font, colours, background, hiding a view, and the free text views.

sections.heading: ChartView settings
sections.summary: JSON block for the chart view and its optional background colour or image.

sections.heading: How to build/design your first Watchface
sections.summary: Parent heading of the step-by-step guide to designing a first watchface.

sections.heading: Tools required
sections.summary: The text and image editors a designer needs, and the 400 x 400 px working size.

sections.heading: Get template to not start from scratch
sections.summary: Getting the default watchface as a starting template with the Export template button in the phone's Wear plugin; the zip lands in the AAPS/exports folder. A connected watch is needed to see the custom watchface buttons.

sections.heading: Organize your files within your computer
sections.summary: A working setup: edit files on the computer, zip them, copy the zip into the phone's AAPS/exports folder and send it to the watch.

sections.heading: Initialize Watchface customization
sections.summary: First design steps: name the watchface, choose which views are visible, rough positioning, and the back-to-front layer order of views.

sections.heading: Manage colors
sections.summary: How colours are written in the JSON (#RRGGBB, #AARRGGBB) and the bgColor value that follows the BG range colours.

sections.heading: Include Hardcoded images
sections.summary: Replacing default images (background, hands, dial) by adding files with fixed names to the zip, including the High/Low variants per BG level.

sections.heading: Tune image color
sections.summary: How the color key tints backgrounds, dials, hands and bitmap images; it has no effect on SVG files.

sections.heading: Use additional fonts for TextViews
sections.summary: Adding custom .ttf/.otf fonts to the zip and referencing them by file name.

sections.heading: Advanced features
sections.summary: Parent heading of the advanced watchface features.

sections.heading: Preferences Feature
sections.summary: A watchface can require and lock some watch display settings (for example Show detailed IOB) if the user allows it with the custom watchface authorization in the Wear plugin preferences; the required count is shown when choosing a watchface.

sections.heading: TwinView Feature
sections.summary: Twin views shift a view to stay centred when its partner view is hidden by a watch setting such as Show Rig Battery or Show AvgDelta.

sections.heading: DynData Feature
sections.summary: Introduction to dynData: animating views from internal values (BG, delta, battery), using the SteamPunk watchface as the example.

sections.heading: Background management
sections.summary: Rotating the background image with BG value through a dynData block (rotationOffset, minData/maxData).

sections.heading: Chart management
sections.summary: Giving the chart view its own background image so it blends with the watchface.

sections.heading: Avg delta management
sections.summary: Switching scale images and rotating pointers with the average delta using freetext views and several dynData blocks.

sections.heading: loop view
sections.summary: Hiding or restyling the loop status arrows with a dynData block on the loop view.

sections.heading: rig_battery and uploader_battery views
sections.summary: Changing battery text colour by battery level with a shared dynData block.

sections.heading: DynPref Feature
sections.summary: Introduction to dynPref: choosing dynData blocks from watch or app preferences.

sections.heading: Simple usage of dynPref within Steampunk watchface
sections.summary: Switching mg/dL and mmol/L images with dynPref on the units preference (key_units).

sections.heading: Combine different preferences within dynPref with AAPS V2
sections.summary: Combining several preferences (Dark, Matching divider, Show detailed IOB) in dynPref blocks to set colours and text size, using the AAPS V2 watchface.

sections.heading: Tips and tricks for dynPref
sections.summary: Pitfalls with dynPref: growing block counts, loops, indexed keys, a single valueKey.

sections.heading: New Features in CustomWatchface V2 (AAPS V3.3.0 or above)
sections.summary: Overview of what Custom Watchface V2 adds; it needs the Wear apk from AAPS 3.3.0 or later.

sections.heading: New Status view
sections.summary: The status view showing IOB, detailed IOB and BGI, and its visibility key.

sections.heading: New TempTarget view
sections.summary: The tempTarget view showing the profile, loop or user temporary target, with colours per type.

sections.heading: New Reservoir Level view
sections.summary: The reservoir view showing reservoir level with warning and urgent colours.

sections.heading: New Formatting feature for DynData or DynPref
sections.summary: Formatting raw values with printf-style strings (dynValue, textvalue1…) including singular/plural labels, with the AAPS (Large) watchface as the example.

sections.heading: Show External data for Follower
sections.summary: Showing data from up to three apps (AAPS, AAPSClient, AAPSClient2) on one watchface: enable broadcasting in the client apps and, if needed, the Switch external data setting of the watchface on the watch.
